cause_quote: The initial resolver rejected parent hops through `!isAgentSessionKey(sessionKey, agentId)` and denied roots without a stored chat type through `return deny(`root session ${sessionKey} has no durable chat type`);`.
user_saw: Owners saw “no host memory authority” when using memory tools in a dashboard session first run by sessions_send or cron, or in a subagent spawned into another agent.
summary: The fix records new dashboard roots as direct chats, grants owner-private memory to eligible cross-agent subagents, makes audience denials visible in logs, and tightens operator memory reads.
reasoning: PR #162176 introduced host-resolved memory audiences with both denials already in place. I checked its introducing diff and confirmed that dashboard session creation at that revision did not supply a chat type and that the later denial-classification change preserved both restrictions.
